subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the global rendered reference image defining the colored pencil sketch aesthetic, sandy coastal terrain, lighting, and composition.
<Picture 2> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the blocky geometric female character proxy in <Video 1> and the lower panel provides the detailed rendered woman (<Subject 1>) with a bun, tactical vest, and field uniform.
<Picture 3> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the simplified wheeled vehicle proxy in <Video 1> and the lower panel provides the textured eight-wheeled ATV (<Subject 2>).
<Picture 4> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the basic shelter proxy in <Video 1> and the lower panel supplies the weathered wooden field station shelter (<Subject 3>).
<Picture 5> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the low-poly beacon tower proxy in <Video 1> and the lower panel supplies the red-and-white striped lighthouse structure (<Subject 4>).
<Picture 6> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the basic observation platform proxy in <Video 1> and the lower panel provides the detailed wooden deck and railing (<Subject 5>).
<Subject 1> is the female ranger clad in a tan field shirt, tactical chest rig, and olive cargo trousers, replacing the geometric female proxy from <Picture 2> and <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the green multi-wheeled field vehicle parked in the distance, replacing the vehicle proxy from <Picture 3> and <Video 1>.
<Subject 3> is the wooden open-sided coastal station shelter, replacing the shelter proxy from <Picture 4> and <Video 1>.
<Subject 4> is the concrete-based red-and-white striped lighthouse on the distant horizon, replacing the tower proxy from <Picture 5> and <Video 1>.
<Subject 5> is the raised wooden observation platform and stepped walkway, replacing the proxy deck structure from <Picture 6> and <Video 1>.
<Video 1> is the reference video governing camera tracking, subject locomotion, timing, and structural layout.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Rendered in the colored-pencil aesthetic established by <Picture 1>, the scene replaces the geometric proxies of <Video 1> with fully textured subjects: <Subject 1> replaces the blocky character, while <Subject 5>, <Subject 4>, <Subject 3>, and <Subject 2> replace the environment and prop proxies, all while preserving the source video's camera path, timing, and locomotion.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (rendered reference frame): attribute_transfer - transfers pencil sketch style, sandy color palette, and lighting to the scene.
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - replaces the low-poly character proxy with the detailed rendered woman from the lower panel of <Picture 2> while retaining locomotion and body positioning from <Video 1>.
<Subject 2>: partially_preserved - transforms the simplified vehicle proxy into the textured eight-wheeled vehicle from the lower panel of <Picture 3> while keeping its background placement from <Video 1>.
<Subject 3>: partially_preserved - upgrades the basic shelter proxy to the wooden coastal shelter from the lower panel of <Picture 4> while maintaining its position from <Video 1>.
<Subject 4>: partially_preserved - converts the basic tower proxy into the detailed striped lighthouse from the lower panel of <Picture 5> while following its horizon placement from <Video 1>.
<Subject 5>: partially_preserved - renders the basic raised deck proxy as the weathered wooden deck and stairs from the lower panel of <Picture 6> while retaining its exact geometry and stairs layout from <Video 1>.
<Video 1> (source editing input): partially_preserved - camera path, timing, and subject animation are preserved while all low-poly visual assets are replaced.

detailed_description:
The video features a colored-pencil illustrative art style defined by <Picture 1>, set in a vast, arid sandy coastal plain under a bright blue sky with wispy clouds. Centered on <Subject 5>, a raised wooden observation platform replacing the basic deck structure from <Video 1>, stands <Subject 1>, a woman with dark hair in a bun wearing a tactical vest, tan shirt, and olive cargo pants who replaces the geometric character proxy from <Video 1>. In the far background, the red-and-white striped lighthouse <Subject 4> sits on the horizon, replacing the tower proxy from <Video 1>. Mid-ground structures such as the wooden shelter <Subject 3> and the all-terrain vehicle <Subject 2> populate the dunes, replacing their respective coarse proxies from <Video 1>. The overall layout, camera position, and subject placement adhere strictly to the spatial foundation of <Video 1>.
